description: Use when an agent must know if a US airport has a ground stop, ground delay program, closure or arrival/departure delay right now. Input: optional airport (FAA/IATA 3-letter like JFK, or ICAO like KJFK); none = every affected airport. Output: JSON per airport flags, max delay minutes, events with reason, avg/max delay, trend, end/reopen times, FAA update time. Not for flight planning. Example: ?airport=SFO Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

airport.description: FAA/IATA code (JFK) or ICAO (KJFK). Omit for all airports with active events

name: travel_us_airports
title: US airport status: FAA ground stops, ground delay programs, closures and delays now
